A.claim: Height-gap hypothesis H: with A^x dominant and A<C, A^x <= (C-1)^z, which would give B^y >= z(C-1)^(z-1), an effective lower bound on B in terms of C.

B.claim: NEGATIVE: for odd prime z in {7,11,13,17,19} there is NO identity P_z(u,v) + c*u^(z-1) = z*R(u,v)^2 over Q (with P_z = Re((u+vi)^z)/u and R homogeneous of degree (z-1)/2), so the one-sided Bennett-type reduction that works for z=3 (direct) and z=5 (4u^4+P_5=5(u^2-v^2)^2) does not extend to (2m,2n,z), z>=7.
